title: Global-sections acyclicity of a K-injective direct image
statement: Let X and Y be schemes and f:X→Y a morphism [def-pc-scheme]. Let I be an arbitrary unbounded K-injective complex of O_X-modules [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Write f_* for module direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image], Qh for localization of the homotopy category [def-pc-derived-category], and Γ_Y for the global-sections functor [def-pc-global-derived-rhom]. The right-derived unit at f_*I, Qh(Γ_Y(f_*I))→RΓ_Y(Qh(f_*I)), is an isomorphism. No quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness, flatness, boundedness, or K-injectivity of f_*I is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0D5T, composed derived direct images, specialized to the global-sections point; Tag 079W, derived adjunction. Global Leray is used in duality.tex, Tag 0B6I. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0D5T and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0B6I.

proof.text: Let p_Y:Y→(pt,Γ(Y,O_Y)) be the global-sections morphism of [def-pc-global-derived-rhom]. Apply [lem-pc-ringed-space-direct-image-kinjective-acyclic] to f and p_Y. This gives invertibility of the right-derived unit for p_Y direct image on f_*I; it needs only K-injectivity of I and does not claim f_*I is K-injective. Use the standard derived category for module sheaves on the point when applying that lemma.

Evaluation on the point is an exact equivalence from module sheaves to Γ(Y,O_Y)-modules. Under this equivalence p_Y direct image is global sections, with the identity action on sections. Right-derived uniqueness identifies their right-derived functors and units: derive the underived natural identification, and use the exact equivalence localization factorization. The global-sections unit at f_*I is therefore the image of the invertible p_Y unit, conjugated by these factorization isomorphisms. Functors and conjugation by isomorphisms preserve invertibility.
